items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: And this is Porter. Porter's in San Diego.

ctx.x: 70. That's the name of my band then. Yeah, one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven. That's right, yeah. You remember most of those bands now? Let's see. The piano player here is Loving Good.
